purpose: Make release-source evidence admissible only when its signed reusable-workflow authority matches the currently active Shine Defence attestation authority.
invariants: The current authority is the latest activation by activatedAt and activation sequence.
A release-source observation is authority-current only when both signed job_workflow_sha and job_workflow_ref equal the current authority activation.
Time freshness never overrides authority freshness.
Release admission must hold when source evidence was produced by an older or unknown attestation authority.
Authority parity is evaluated independently for every required active Railway estate target.
